subject: Expansion ops: enabling three new product teams - governance & billing cadence
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aperturelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion ops: enabling three new product teams - governance & billing cadence

Hi Elena —

Great talking yesterday. Per our conversation, Aperture is planning to add three additional product teams under the existing account (Search UX, Billing Integration, and Data Studio). To make onboarding predictable we recommend the following: 

- SOW to cover the extra API keys, a 90-day staged activation (one team every two weeks), and a non-prod sandbox for each team.
- Billing cadence: convert the current monthly usage bill to a consolidated monthly invoice with line items per project (helps procurement).
- Governance: scoped role-based API key naming convention + rotation policy (we’ll provide a short runbook).

I've attached a draft SOW (SOW_expansion_v3.docx) that reflects the staged rollouts and capacity bump. If this looks good, procurement can issue a PO and we’ll schedule a kickoff.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the team start dates (target weeks are 4/5, 4/19, 5/3).
2) Procurement issues a PO referencing RW-2027-1874-A.
3) Internal ops (Ben/Laura) schedule the enablement playbook run for 4/7.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the SOW line-by-line.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126
[Attachment: SOW_expansion_v3.docx]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aperturelabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@aperturelabs.com>, procurement@aperturelabs.com
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion ops: enabling three new product teams - governance & billing cadence

Thanks, Soojin — this looks like the right direction. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Start dates: can we shift the first team one week later (4/12) because of a sprint freeze? The other two weeks work.
- Billing: procurement prefers one consolidated invoice but needs line-item visibility for each project (that’s fine).
- Governance: can you confirm the rotation policy timing (30 vs 90 days) and whether the sandbox keys will be separable from prod in billing?

Tom from our infra team will also review the SOW for networking notes — looping him in. Once procurement issues the PO we’ll route to legal for a quick review; target is to have a PO to you by 4/1.

Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Product | Aperture Labs
elena.ruiz@aperturelabs.com | +1 617-555-0199
